about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Who we are and how we teach
about.whyLead: We are not here to rob you. We are here to give you a chance
about.r1: No overpriced courses draining your wallet
about.r2: Transparent pricing — no hidden fees or upsells
about.r3: An IELTS 8.0 certified teacher who actually teaches
about.r4: Study with or without a tutor — your choice
about.r5: Live streams for questions and speaking practice
about.r6: Free mock tests and level assessments
about.r8: Video lessons, notes and graded tests
about.r9: Community support, not just a transaction
about.r10: Learn at your own pace, without pressure
about.h1d: Study on your own with videos and notes, or take lessons with a teacher. Both are affordable
about.h2d: High-quality video lessons, graded tests and downloadable materials
about.h3d: Ask questions live, practise speaking and meet other learners
about.h4d: Take mock tests, get feedback and see your growth week by week
about.m1d: Quality education at a sane price, not an outrageous one. No debt, no gatekeeping
about.m2d: Study with materials on your own or join live streams. Ask questions, go at your pace
about.m3d: We know you have work, study and a life besides English
about.m4d: No empty promises — only what works
about.heroTitle: Education should be accessible, not a luxury
about.heroLead: We want to change the English learning market in Uzbekistan, where lessons cost far more than they should, and make quality teaching available to everyone, not only the wealthy
about.story1: We were tired of watching people pay hundreds a month for mediocre courses from teachers who show off instead of teaching. People go into debt to learn English. It should not be this way
about.story2: So we built a platform where a sane price gets you everything: a structured course, live streams, teacher feedback and a community that actually cares
about.howLead: Simple, transparent and to the point. No fluff
about.teamLead: Two people who got tired of how things work and decided to fix it
about.bioFounder: Saw how the market works and said enough. Built this platform to make learning accessible
about.bioTeacher: Someone who teaches with genuine interest. No arrogance, just results
about.teamNote: That is all. No huge team with grand titles — two people who care and a teacher who actually teaches
about.joinLead: Let us break the system that overcharges for English. Start learning at a sane price
about.joinNote: No card needed. No conditions. Just learn
